title: chargehand run summary, v1
description: One row of a run list (ADR 0039): enough to show a run's state, cost and pull request without reading its result.

parent_run_id.description: Set when a driven session started this run (its research and review calls).

task_ref.description: The tracker item id or task id the run was started for.

usd.description: Priced by the orchestrator's table; null when the cost is unknown or the credential is not priced.

error_code.description: result/v1's error.code of a failed run.

name.description: A friendly name for the run, like "Brave Capybara", derived from the run id. For people: not unique, so match on the id.

actor.description: The account that started the run (ADR 0050); null for a run started from the CLI.

kind.description: batch: a request with a driven block; single: any other.

repository.description: context.repository.path of the request; null when it named none.

commit.description: context.repository.commit of the request: the commit the run's citations are checked against.

tokens.description: Input plus output tokens of the finished run's result; null while it runs.
